text:
Maya R: quick check-in on the metrics table: can we standardize how sparklines handle axis labels, legends, smoothing presets, and outlier flags? trying to lock down copy and keyboard flows before devs start the build. screenshot: https://img.redwood.com/table-sparkline-v2

Kevin L: main thread: axis labeling. i'd prefer showing units only in column header (e.g., "Latency (ms)") and avoid small inline axis text on each sparkline. saves clutter and keeps rows tight.

Tara P: agree on header unit. but we need a discoverable per-sparkline unit on hover for screen readers and touch. propose tooltip: "Unit: ms. Range: 10-200ms". also add aria-description on the svg.

Noah W: smoothing UI: current mock has a 3-way segmented control (Off / Smooth / Aggressive). usability concern: ambiguous what those mean numerically. can we add microcopy: "Smooth = 5-s EMA; Aggressive = 15-s EMA" and show it in a small help popover?

Maya R: good call. shorter labels for the control still. maybe "Off / Low / High" and the popover gives the math. keep tooltips under 2 lines.

Kevin L: outlier handling option: two schools: clip (clamp y-axis) vs annotate (show spike with marker). clipping makes patterns easier to read but hides real incidents. annotate preserves truth. Leaning annotate with visual de-emphasis (thin stroke + hollow circle).

Tara P: for accessibility, annotated outliers must be focusable with keyboard and have clear labels: e.g., "Outlier: 980ms at 14:03 UTC". they should appear in the DOM order after the sparkline path.

Noah W: performance note: rendering an extra point layer for large tables could add DOM nodes. optimize by rendering outliers as a single canvas layer or combine into an SVG group where possible. devs should benchmark.

Maya R: copy for legend/legendless mode: if the dashboard is dense, we hide legends and rely on column headers + hover. Otherwise (expanded chart view) show legend with color label and unit.

Kevin L: quick copy suggestion for hover tooltip: "Avg latency · 15m · Smoothing: Low (5-point EMA)". short, includes smoothing state.

Tara P: keyboard flow proposal: tab to sparkline (focus ring), press Enter to open mini-menu, arrow keys move between options, Esc closes and returns focus to sparkline. live region should announce changes like "Smoothing set to Low".

DesignBot: accessibility scan: missing live region hooks in prototype, some interactive points lack role="button". see /design/accessibility-checklist.md.

Maya R: action list: 1) @Kevin L finalize header unit copy + telemetry events for hover/tooltips, 2) @Noah W prototype outlier layer perf comparison (SVG group vs canvas), 3) @Tara P write tooltip and popover microcopy and keyboard spec, 4) i'll update design files with Off/Low/High labels and annotate outlier style (hollow + dashed outline).

Kevin L: i'll add events: `metric.sparkline.hover`, `metric.sparkline.options.open`, `metric.sparkline.smoothing.set`, and `metric.outlier.view`

Noah W: will run perf tests this week, aim to have numbers by Wed.

Tara P: will draft the keyboard interaction doc and example ARIA attributes.

Maya R: thanks all. plan to ship to staging after perf numbers and a11y sign-off. check back in 10 days. :white_check_mark:

DesignBot: thread archived after 3 days of inactivity.
